screens.screen: wallets (المحافظ) - 'محافظي' tab with budget progress, delete/hide actions and the 'محفظة جديدة' scrolling FAB
home / balance (الرئيسية): user header, balance dashboard, 4 action tiles, bottom navigation
approval requests (طلبات الموافقة) - 'المعلقة' tab with accept/reject

notes: 2022 Material 2 app; colours from colors.dart (#2E547C / #2D7B6F), fonts are the repo's own JF Flat, Montserrat Light and Iconly-Broken icon font; tile/bottom-bar images are the repo's assets. Strings come from translations/ar.json. Amounts print as raw doubles (e.g. 6000.0) followed by the rial sign because that is what the code does. Numbers are consistent: 4 wallets total 12500.0 with 9450.0 still available, total balance 30000.0 so 17500.0 outside wallets; requests refer to the same wallets. The status-bar area is white on the home tab as it would be on iOS (the blue statusBarColor in the code only applies on Android). The ScrollingFabAnimated package source was not available locally, so its 200x60 rounded shape is drawn from the package defaults as remembered. Request date strings follow DateFormat('EEE, MMM d, hh:mm aaa','ar').
